description: Save keywords to a project's saved-keywords list. FREE — database only, charges no credits. Idempotent: re-saving an existing keyword is a no-op. If tags are provided, missing tags may be created. Tags are appended to whatever tags a keyword already carries. Ask the user for confirmation before applying or replacing tags broadly. Keywords are normalised and de-duplicated before they are written, so `savedCount` is the number of DISTINCT keywords now saved by this call — it can be lower than the number of entries submitted, and that is the figure to report. Saving does not fetch metrics: a keyword saved here has null volume/difficulty/CPC until research_keywords has run for it.

languageCode.description: Language code (e.g. 'en', 'es', 'fr'). Omit it to use the project's default market language, which falls back to 'en'.

locationCode.description: DataForSEO location code. Omit it to use the project's default market, which falls back to 2840 (United States) for a project that has not set one. See dataforseo.com/help-center/locations. Some countries (e.g. Iceland, 2352) are served from Google Ads data: keyword volume/CPC/trends work, but keyword difficulty, search intent, and domain analytics are unavailable.

projectId.description: Required. The MisarSEO project ID to scope this call to. Get one from list_projects.

tags.description: Optional tags to attach to every saved keyword. Ask the user for explicit confirmation before using this, especially when saving many keywords or creating new tag names.

name: save_keywords
